description: One reason something was refused, as a host sends it to a client: the data form of a Riddler.Finding, every key present. A client switches on code, which does not change when the wording of message does. The codes are not enumerated, so a code a later release adds is a finding in the same form, and a key a later release adds is not refused. The schema is versioned with the package: it changes only in a release, and that release's changelog names the change.

author_message.description: The text the document's author set for this finding's code on the question whose response it is about, or null. Only a finding response validation raises carries a string here; message stays the package's own sentence, and a client shows this where it is a string and its own text otherwise.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable reason, such as submit.missing_field or response.required.

element_key.description: The key of the document element the finding belongs to; null where there is no key a host can look an element up by.

field.description: What the finding is about: the refused construct, field or key; null when the refusal is about the input as a whole.

message.description: The package's own sentence naming what was refused.

position.description: Where in some source text the refusal is, both counts one-based, or null. The unit a column counts is the one the Riddler.Finding documentation names for the finding's code.

title: Finding
